title: Emily Harrington
html:
I’ve worked with In The Light twice. They’ve done a small repair on my mother’s house, and now a full roof replacement on my own house. Both times they were fast and very professional. We liked that we were able to see progress photos in the customer portal throughout the day, and the crew did a great job leaving no trace behind when they finished.

John in particular was extremely dedicated to making sure we were happy with the final product. He has followed up with me several times to make sure the repair at my mom’s house held up well, and walked through all of the progress photos on our roof replacement. Great customer service and very knowledgeable, as well.

title: Kat Hinkle
html: I had a “drip” for years which, eventually, turned into Niagara Falls. I desperately needed immediate help. In The Light Roofing took care of it quickly and efficiently! They also took care of me, as I am a special needs customer, and I told them about my condition. The workers were knowledgeable and FAST, and the price was extremely reasonable, way under what I was expecting; they even helped me with financing! Yesterday, day #1 since the repair was completed, we had torrential rain. The roof is 100% perfect! I give this company my highest recommendations (and I am fussy)! Oh, and I foretold them about my 3 large, friendly dogs, and they were kind and compassionate towards them, also!

title: Nathan “cappydoo”
html: After noticing multiple leaks forming in my my 23+ year old roof and have numerous companies come and give estimates on work no one was more a pleasure then In the light roofing. Having never been in the situation of needing a new roof before until now the process was extremely easy due to the hassle free and straight forward employees involved. From getting an inspection and estimate to the crew who installed/ cleaned up the outside of my home. They take great pride and integrity in the work they do fixing issues that other companies may have skipped over. Their price was very fair for the quality of work they provide as i had two companies give quotes lower and higher then In The Light Roofing. Overall very impressed and will tell friends and family to use them in the future.

html: At no point in my experience with this company was I ever disappointed. From the moment John came out to give me an estimate to the completion of the job, I was always impressed with the knowledge, integrity, work ethic, competency, and true kindness that everyone demonstrated. I am thrilled with my new roof and would absolutely recommend this company to anyone needing any kind of roofing services.

title: Paul Heric
html: The In the Light Roofing crew just completed a new roof installation on our home. The experience was top notch from the first phone call to the final product. The job was challenging due to the roof configuration but the crew handled it like pros. The communication was frequent and thoughtful. There were some delays in getting materials and Johnathan kept us up to date and informed on progress, only scheduling the install when all the materials were in hand. As with any large project unexpected issues arise. This group addressed all concerns and questions professionally, without any hassle, to be sure the job was done right and that we were totally satisfied. The customer truly comes first at ITL roofing. In this world of getting what you pay for, we truly got a quality job, done right, for a reasonable price. Gladly recommend this organization.

title: Lori Frankenfield Hines
html:
Wanted to take the time to speak on an experience I have had with a local roofing company. In the light roofing, came and gave us an estimate for some minor roof repairs. When they came to do the repair they found water damage under the area to be repaired. The wood was all rotted and there was more work involved than originally expected. They could have covered it up and walked away, we would have never known the difference. However they did the right thing and let us know. They did all the repairs the correct way and for that I am grateful.

In the light roofing, you are number one in our book!
